```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from datetime import datetime

# Load the CSV file into a DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')

# Create a function to display the weather data
def display_weather():
    # Display the first few rows of the DataFrame
    print(df.head())
    
    # Create a figure and axis
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    
    # Plot the temperature, rainfall, and air quality
    ax.plot(df['date'], df['temp_c'], label='Temperature')
    ax.plot(df['date'], df['precip_mm'], label='Precipitation')
    ax.plot(df['date'], df['aqi'], label='Air Quality')
    
    # Add labels and title
    ax.set_xlabel('Date')
    ax.set_ylabel('Value')
    ax.set_title('Weather Data')
    
    # Add legend
    ax.legend()
    
    # Show the plot
    plt.show()

# Create a function to save the current view as a high-resolution PNG
def save_view_as_png():
    # Get the current date and time
    now = datetime.now()
    
    # Create a filename based on the current date and time
    filename = f"weather_{now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}.png"
    
    # Save the plot as a PNG file
    plt.savefig(filename)
    
    print(f"View saved as {filename}")

# Main function to run the program
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Call the display_weather function to show the initial data
    display_weather()
    
    # Call the save_view_as_png function to save the current view as a PNG
    save_view_as_png()
```

```python
# Load the CSV file into a DataFrame

# Plotting the revenue vs. order volume with region-colored points

# Drawing the uncertainty ribbons

plt.title('Uncertainty Ribbons')
plt.xlabel('Month')
plt.ylabel('Orders')
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
```

```python
from datetime import datetime

sunset_sunset_times = [sunset_times[city] for city in weather_data['city']]

plt.plot(sunset_sunset_times, marker='o', linestyle='-', color='blue', label='Sunset')

plt.title('Sunrise and Sunset Times')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)

# Write the result to a video file
```
